info.description:
PimaBill is a multi-tenant billing and subscription management API. It supports African and global payment providers including Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, Pesapal, MTN MoMo and Airtel Money.

## Authentication
- **JWT (Bearer)**: Used for tenant management endpoints (`/api/tenants/me/*`, `/api/auth/*`). Obtain tokens via `/api/auth/login`.
- **API Key**: Used for all billing resource endpoints (customers, plans, subscriptions, invoices, payments, analytics). Pass your API key in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer sk_live_...`.

## Webhooks
Payment provider webhooks are received at `/webhooks/{provider}` (no `/api` prefix). Configure your provider dashboard to point to these URLs.
PimaBill also forwards billing events to your application via the webhook URL configured in your tenant settings.

post.description: Receives payment callbacks from DPO Group. The transaction is verified with DPO before anything changes.
Receives payment event notifications from Flutterwave. The verif-hash header must match the secret hash saved with your Flutterwave credentials; the outcome is then confirmed with Flutterwave.

Receives PayPal notifications. Each one is verified with PayPal (verify-webhook-signature) using the webhook id saved with your PayPal credentials; approved orders are captured before the payment is marked paid.
Receives payment event notifications from Paystack. The signature is verified using HMAC-SHA512 of the raw body with the provider's secret key.
Receives IPNs from PayU South Africa. The transaction is looked up with PayU before anything changes.
Receives IPN callbacks from Pesapal. The transaction status is fetched from Pesapal before anything changes.
Receives event notifications from Stripe (e.g. checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded). Every notification must carry a valid stripe-signature for the configured webhook secret.
Same processing as the shared /webhooks/{provider} URL, scoped to one tenant. Point new provider webhook configurations here; the dashboard shows the exact URL for each provider.
